senses.gloss:
मृकण्डक m. (-कः) The name of a saint; also called MĀRKAṆḌEYA. E.
मृकण्ड the name of his father, and वुन् aff.

मृकण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) The saint MĀRKAṆḌEYA.
 E. मृकण्डु his father, अण्
aff.; but the word unchanged.

मृक्ष् r. 1st cl. (मृक्षति) To accumulate, to collect, to fill. r. 10th cl.
(मृक्षयति)
 1. To mix, to mingle, to blend or combine.
 2. To speak
incorrectly.
